findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, get_item, trending, find_similar, complete_the_look, shop_the_look, rate_results, sign_guestbook · Private data: get_item · Public sink: search, get_item, trending, find_similar, complete_the_look, shop_the_look · Destructive: sign_guestbook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, get_item, trending, find_similar, complete_the_look, shop_the_look, rate_results, sign_guestbook · Private data: get_item · Public sink: search, get_item, trending, find_similar, complete_the_look, shop_the_look · Destructive: sign_guestbook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
